message: Hi Jane, it was great meeting you at the event! I'm really keen on connecting with some University of Riverdale alumni for my new venture. Could you help me out with some contacts?
Morning Jane! Don't forget our lunch at 1 PM today.
Jane, I've sent the final draft of the alumni newsletter. Could you give it a final look?

Alex, I've found a contact that might be of interest to you. Brian Smith, an alumnus of Riverdale, has been making waves in the tech industry. I can't share personal contact details, but here's his LinkedIn profile.
Hi Jane, I've updated my mailing address for the Riverdale Alumni Gazette. My new address is 742 Evergreen Terrace, Springfield, IL 62704. Looking forward to the next edition!
